It could be given to a child who is expected to grow up and assume a position of power or leadership in their community. The name could also be applied to someone who has already achieved such a status, giving them an additional title of respect.
data.spiritual_significance: In the Islamic context, the name Raafe can be seen as a reminder of one’s spiritual goals and the need to strive for moral and ethical excellence in all aspects of life. Just as this name denotes a lofty position in worldly terms, so too does it represent the aspiration to attain a noble rank in the sight of Allah. In Sufism, it could also be interpreted as a reference to the Divine Companion, or Ar-Rafi‘ (The Exalter), who helps the believer to rise above their earthly concerns and reach spiritual heights.
